entries.e79e34ee364eca9a: This business sells products wholesale to franchisees and major customers. FC stores is the collective term for stores with which the company has a basic contract for use of its product ordering system; as of March 31, 2026, there were 33 such stores. It also exports to overseas FC stores and sells wholesale to domestic agents; revenue from FC stores in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,972 million, and combined revenue from wholesale and overseas sales was ¥561 million.
